maintenance_led.reason: Sells consumer razors, sunscreen, feminine care and skin care products (Schick, Banana Boat, Wet Ones); mostly consumables and first-time purchases.

publicly_funded.reason: Revenue comes from consumers buying personal care brands through retailers, not government payers.

serial_acquirer.reason: Grows mainly through its brands and product innovation; acquisitions like Billie, Cremo and Jack Black are occasional.

mission_critical.reason: Consumers can easily switch among razors, sunscreens and skin care brands at retail; commodity-like, low switching cost.
